propositions: Dense multi-criterion completion-verifier runs exhaust request budget without banking any criterion verdicts because Pydantic AI executes tool batches concurrently, deferring all record calls past the bounded limit.

The existing completion contract relies only on prompt instructions to serialize evidence and commit banking actions, which cannot enforce one governed action per response when the model batches tools in parallel.

Completion evidence collection must atomically claim one governed action per response step, count unique evidence responses for each criterion, and invoke provisional met=false banking at response three if the criterion remains unbanked.

The completion-only policy wrapper must be composed between existing memo and runaway-guard layers to reject concurrent same-response actions before they reach real repository tools while preserving runaway accounting.

Primary and successor completion paths must attach the same `CompletionEvidencePolicy` to the record tool with live per-criterion boundary detection and fail-closed fallback record invocation to guarantee progress before budget exhaustion.
